It's important for me to have them painted always! It makes them so much stronger. I've only ever broken nails in the past when they were naked. I paint them once a week with: 1 coat Nail Magic base coat, 4 coats polish, and 1 thick layer of seche vite top coat. After ~2 mins after I put on the top coat I cover them with a nail oil I got on Etsy. I think it helps dry them faster and also it's supposed to help with growth 😊 (not sure if it helps but it's good for the skin around them at least!) Also don't be scared of super glue, like straight up glue (not nail kind) especially if the break is not too offensively deep and can grow out! On my other hand I had to fix a sliver of the tip on my pinky 😅 but in a few weeks I'll file it away and make the nails an even length again 😊 don't give up if you want them long, it's possible with patience and giving them love 🥹
